status_at_registration: no E6b (resnet-tln) run and no E7 (CIFAR) run has been executed; training-results.json holds 96/96 E6 runs, all device=cpu, models = ph, resnet, resnet-ln, cayley
question: Does the port-Hamiltonian stream's operator-bound architecture offer better stability or trainability at depth on real data, without unacceptable losses in predictive performance, training speed, or memory?

protocol.mechanism_preserving_adaptation: shared linear stem to 8x8xd; stream blocks differ only in the trunk update; all non-PH families share the identical branch Conv1x1(tanh(Conv3x3(z))); PH places Conv3x3 inside the port input u=tanh(Conv3x3(z)) with B a 1x1 port, so Cayley transport C and contraction Lambda act on channels only and the port budget holds per position exactly
protocol.optimizer: Adam, cosine decay to lr*1e-3, batch 256, weight decay 0, no gradient clipping (instability must be observable), 30 epochs, early stopping on validation accuracy (patience 8) with best-checkpoint restore
protocol.splits: CIFAR train 45000 / validation 5000 / test 10000; split rng seeded 1000+seed; standard per-channel normalization; RandomCrop(32,4)+HorizontalFlip on train only; test set never used for model selection or hyperparameter tuning; learning rate selected per (model, depth, seed) on validation, identical grid for every architecture
protocol.capacity_note: params per block: ph 12d^2, cayley 11d^2, resnet/resnet-ln/resnet-tln 10d^2 (+2d for LN variants); d=64 for all families; counts recorded per run and reported
protocol.device_policy: CUDA GPU required (hard exit if unavailable); fp32; cudnn.benchmark on (documented non-determinism); device, GPU name, torch/cudnn versions recorded per run

E6b resnet-tln (synthetic, completing th.forward_growth: O(1), predicted in [0.5, 2.0] at every depth — the trunk is re-scaled every layer by construction
E6b resnet-tln (synthetic, completing th.accuracy: parity with resnet-ln on circles-4 (>= 0.95 at depth 240)
E6b resnet-tln (synthetic, completing th.operator_bound: none — LN is a per-sample statistic; no input-independent bound exists for this variant, which is the point of the comparison
E6b resnet-tln (synthetic, completing th.gradient_max_ratio: unbounded in principle; empirically expected <= 2 at depth <= 240

E7a ph (CIFAR-10).test_accuracy: non-inferior to the best baseline within 1.0 pt at every depth (margin pre-set); absolute accuracy expected 0.82-0.90 at d=64 (mechanism comparison, not a tuned SOTA configuration, no normalizer in the PH stream and no hyperparameter search beyond the shared LR grid)
E7a ph (CIFAR-10).forward_growth: lowest of the five families at L>=48, and strictly inside the measured port budget (violations = 0)
E7a ph (CIFAR-10).resnet_ln_and_tln: branch-LN does not control trunk growth (E6 prediction replicated on real data: growth within 2x of plain resnet); trunk-LN pins growth near O(1)
E7a ph (CIFAR-10).stability: zero PH divergent/NaN runs; if any baseline diverges at L=96 while PH does not, that is support for the stability claim
E7a ph (CIFAR-10).efficiency: PH per-epoch wall-clock within 1.5x of the fastest baseline at matched depth (two extra d x d solves and one eigendecomposition per block); peak memory within 1.5x; params within 1.25x of the mean baseline

decision_rules.evidence_for_practical_advantage: ALL of: (1) PH test accuracy >= best_baseline - 1.0 pt at every depth (mean over seeds); (2) PH median forward growth < resnet and resnet-ln at L>=48; (3) PH port-budget violations = 0; (4) zero PH failed runs while at least one baseline failure exists at any depth, or a strictly lower instability-event count; (5) efficiency guard holds
decision_rules.evidence_against: ANY of: accuracy deficit > 1.5 pt at any depth; any PH divergent/NaN run; per-epoch time or peak memory > 1.5x fastest baseline; forward growth ratio vs resnet >= 0.8x (no norm-signature difference)
decision_rules.neutral_outcome: accuracy parity + norm signature present + no instability events for ANY architecture: conservation holds, practical advantage undemonstrated at this scale — reported as such, no spin
decision_rules.reporting: means and std over seeds, all failed runs listed, test set touched once per run at the final selected checkpoint; if PH performs worse it is reported and analyzed, not buried

separate_math_verification: code/p-027-tests.py (13-assertion law suite) runs before any training in the Colab entry point; additionally every trained PH run self-checks the port budget numerically on real batches (violation count must be 0, recorded per run)
